Done. Created **`todo_ollama-qwen3.8-flash-next-125b-a6b-q4_01.html`** (383 lines) — a single self-contained file with all HTML, CSS, and JS inline.

**Features delivered:**
- **Add todos** — input + Add button (Enter key works too); empty/whitespace input is ignored
- **Mark complete** — checkbox or click the text; completed items get strikethrough + muted color
- **Delete** — × button on each item
- **Filters** — All / Active / Completed pill buttons with an empty-state message per filter
- **localStorage persistence** — todos survive reloads, with safe load/save (handles corrupt data and unavailable storage gracefully)

Extras: live "N items left" counter, "Clear completed" button, subtle animations, and accessible labels (`aria-label`, `aria-live`). Just open the file in any browser.
